metadata.title: Broadcom's $16 Billion AI Quarter Faces the Marvell Timing Trap

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO), the semiconductor and infrastructure-software giant, heads into a high-pressure AI earnings test on September 2, with shares priced at $372.76 Friday. Nvidia reignited the AI rally. Now Wall Street wants Broadcom to prove its custom-chip boom is arrivingnot waiting somewhere over the horizon.
The numbers are already enormous. Broadcom's second-quarter results delivered $22.19 billion in revenue and $10.26 billion in free cash flow. AI semiconductor revenue exploded 143% to $10.8 billion. Management expects third-quarter revenue near $29.4 billion, including approximately $16 billion from AI chipsgrowth above 200%.
The valuation snapshot is blunt: Broadcom's $372.76 share price stands 7.18% above its $347.79 GF Value estimate. AI would generate roughly 54% of projected quarterly revenue, up from approximately 49% last quarter. That mix is powerful, but the premium leaves little room for excuses. Marvell's (NASDAQ:MRVL)M Friday plunge showed what happens when giant AI contracts produce distant promises instead of immediate sales. Broadcom must show the chips are shipping and the revenue is landing now.
